criteria.criterion: 自然选用安装版Skill并有效路由；不回写旧截止或声称事前预测
criteria.evidence: Trace reads installed money-craft SKILL and earnings references; earnings/quick/chat route READY; explicitly separates execution date and historical cutoff.

criteria.criterion: 区分GAAP与调整后盈利，按披露的税后调整桥，不用名义税率编造税效
criteria.evidence: Uses disclosed 593 pretax / 441 aftertax / 0.97 per-share adjustment; correctly separates reported and adjusted earnings. Issuer EPS growth rates retained with rounding caveat.

criteria.criterion: 旧新年度指引同口径对照；不把较高GAAP上限当作盈利修复，不将指引当已实现值
criteria.evidence: Compares March and May adjusted guidance, marks midpoint as provisional assumption and excludes GAAP settlement uplift from ongoing earnings.

criteria.criterion: 现金流复算与FCF proxy边界准确，不将季报简单年化或宣称可分配现金
criteria.evidence: Recomputes both quarterly FCF proxies and cash bridge, identifies working-capital components without equating them to total change; rejects annualization and distributable-cash interpretation.

criteria.criterion: 反方和下一窗口明确，数字/回执正确，未把假设自动转为交易动作
criteria.evidence: Digital comp is counterevidence; Q2 sales, adjusted margin, inventory/cash and guidance are next checks. No prediction score, price target or transaction. No old thesis supplied to host, correctly limits thesis claims.

limitations: Retrospective replay, not a blind forecast score.
